ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory continuous screening of all shareholders, directors, officers, UBOs, and platform counterparties against the Belize FIU Reference List, United Nations Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, and EU/UK restrictive measures. Enhanced due diligence is required for any PEP, family members, close associates, or persons resident in high-risk jurisdictions. Adverse media screening and independent source-of-funds verification must be completed and documented before incorporation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registry of Companies, International Business Companies Registry Online Services, Belize
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be registrable in Latin script; English romanization or transliteration is required where the proposed name is drawn from a non-Latin script. The registry accepts English-language names and permits use of a second foreign-language name subject to furnishing an English translation and transliteration.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant must obtain the Registrar's written statement of grounds. Within 14 days the applicant may file a written administrative appeal with the Registrar of Companies together with revised names or supporting evidence that the proposed name is not confusing, prohibited, or offensive. If the administrative appeal is denied, the applicant may seek judicial review before the Supreme Court of Belize under the applicable constitutional and administrative law procedures.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office cannot serve as the statutory registered office. The International Business Company must maintain a fixed physical registered office in Belize, with a mail-forwarding back office provided by a licensed registered agent. The office must have physical file storage capacity and personnel able to receive official correspondence.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Moderate-to-high for a high-risk financial intermediary; the estimated probability of an unannounced physical inspection of the registered agent premises within the first operating year is 30-45%.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Business Companies Act, Cap. 270 (Laws of Belize, Revised Edition 2020), ss. 5–8 (Incorporation), s. 37 (Registered Office), s. 44 (Directors), s. 46 (Officers)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Belize Companies Registry, Ministry of Finance, Economic Development and Investment, Belize City, Belize
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation of an International Business Company (Form IBC-1) together with executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; IBC may declare a minimal issued capital of US$1.00; no escrow, capital deposit, or solvency certificate required at incorporation
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [Company Name] (IBC). RESOLVED, that the subscriber's subscription for the authorized share capital as set forth in the Memorandum of Association be hereby approved, ratified and accepted. RESOLVED, that the registered office located at [Registered Office Address], Belize, and the licensed registered agent be and are hereby approved. RESOLVED, that [Director Name] is duly appointed as Director, [Name] as Chairman and President, [Name] as Corporate Secretary, and [Name] as Treasurer. RESOLVED, that the President and Treasurer be jointly authorized to execute agreements, open escrow and bank accounts, with dual-signatory authority for all wire transfers exceeding US$5,000. RESOLVED, that the corporate seal and share certificate specimens be adopted by this board.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Belize Companies Registry (registered agent licensed under Cap. 270)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute a registered-agent engagement agreement with a licensed Belize registered agent who will file statutory forms, maintain the registered office, and hold the corporate minute book. Provide certified passport copies, proof of residential address, and a banker's or professional reference for the intended beneficial owners and directors.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent rejects the KYC file, supplement with notarized source-of-funds statements and enhanced due diligence forms; defective documents may be re-submitted within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request through the registered agent, proposing three alternative names in descending preference. The proposed name must not conflict with existing Belize entities or contain words implying government patronage, financial institution status, or regulated activity without prior consent.
required_dossiers: Consent letters for restricted words (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a name is rejected, the registry will issue a name-conflict notice; a substituted second-choice name may be filed, with re-filing fees waived when submitted within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent (notarial certification by a Belize Notary Public)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association containing the corporate name, registered office address, authorized share capital (e.g., 5,000 no-par-value shares), business purpose clause covering digital intermediary and crowdfunding facilitation, and director/indemnification clauses. Execution by the incorporator/subscriber before a Belize notary public.
required_dossiers: Consent to Act as Director & Officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry queries drafting deficiencies, the registered agent will file amended clauses reflecting registry comments within 3 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application and Payment of Statutory Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form IBC-1, the executed Charter documents, and government fees (US$200 for authorized capital up to 50,000 shares) to the Companies Registry via the licensed registered agent. The registry issues a Certificate of Incorporation upon lodgement and fee verification.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Queryable filings are returned with a defect notice; corrections must be lodged within 14 days of the notice, accompanied by a US$25 re-lodgement fee for each re-submission cycle.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Corporate Seal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the registry issues the Certificate of Incorporation evidencing the creation of a separate legal entity with limited liability. The registered agent then arranges the company seal, share certificates, and statutory registers (register of members, directors, officers, and charges).
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Minor clerical errors on the Certificate may be rectified via a Certificate of Correction filed with the registry within 7 business days, at no additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Resolutions, Issue of Shares, and Officer Appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Corporate Registrar/Board of Directors (in-house action evidenced in the corporate records held at the registered office)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting (or execute written resolutions in lieu of meeting). Adopt the pro-forma First Board Resolution, allot subscriber shares, appoint directors and officers, approve bank signatories, and adopt the corporate seal. Record minutes and maintain them at the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any director's consent is defective, a replacement consent or resignation and appointment resolution is executed retroactively and minuted; regulators may require a declaration of regularity.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: International Financial Services Commission (IFSC) of Belize
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the prescribed licence application for a crowdfunding portal under the International Financial Services Commission Act, Cap. 272 and the Securities Industry Act, 2019. Provide the constitutive documents, compliance manual, AML/CFT programme, operational and technology infrastructure descriptions, escrow protocol, and business continuity plan. Pay the non-refundable application fee and await ministerial licensing review.
required_dossiers: Escrow Agent Agreement with licensed Belize bank
Fit-and-proper declarations for directors and principal officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the IFSC issues a 'minded-to-refuse' notice or requests further information, respond with supplementary legal opinions and operational remediation within 30 calendar days; a refusal may be appealed to the Minister of Finance under ss. 46-48 of Cap. 272.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: International Financial Services Commission (IFSC) of Belize, in coordination with the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) for AML supervision
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Equity Crowdfunding Portal Licence issued under the International Financial Services Commission Act, Cap. 272 and the Securities Industry Act, 2019

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environment, Ministry of Sustainable Development, Climate Change and Disaster Risk Management, Belize
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 3 – Exempt Registration (office-based digital financial intermediary with no industrial discharge, no land disturbance, and de minimis environmental footprint)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater discharge; domestic sewage subject to Belize Wastewater Effluent Standards (BOD ≤ 50 mg/L, TSS ≤ 50 mg/L); site small-scale electrical/electronic waste to approved e-waste recyclers per Environmental Protection Act, Cap. 328; indoor air quality maintained with negligible VOC emissions from data server equipment (annual certification of HVAC compliance required).

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Certificate from the Belize National Fire Service (serviced portable fire extinguishers, emergency egress plan, smoke-detection and alarm system); structural load inspection certification for server/operational areas from the Central Building Authority; workplace clearance from the Labour Department under the Occupational Safety and Health (OSH) Act, Cap. 302 including first-aid kit, ergonomic workstation compliance, and employee safety training records.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Belize Tax Service (BTS), Ministry of Finance, Economic Development and Investment; official portal: https://taxservice.gov.bz. Customs: Belize Customs and Excise Department via the Customs Border Management System. Corporate registry: Companies and Corporate Affairs Registry (CCAR), Ministry of Investment.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign owners of a Belize IBC obtain the statutory identifier through: (1) incorporation under the International Business Companies Act, Cap. 270, at CCAR, issuing Certificate of Incorporation; (2) automatic issuance of the Business Tax Identification Number (BTIN) by BTS upon registration on the taxservice.gov.bz portal, using the CCAR company number as reference; (3) filing Form GST-01 with BTS only if the IBC makes taxable supplies in Belize (e.g., services to Belize residents) or voluntarily elects GST registration; (4) annual filing of the Economic Substance Notification and IBC Declaration on the BTS portal. No income tax registration or return obligation arises because the IBC is statutorily exempt from Belize income tax on non-Belize-source income and has no domestic trading nexus.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone: the IBC is a Belize-incorporated, non-resident limited corporation whose foreign-source income, capital, assets and transactions enjoy a 50-year exemption from income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax and stamp duty (IBC Act s.140); the entity cannot elect pass-through status, as Belize law treats it as a per se corporation.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box regime exists. Available elections: (a) stamp-duty exemption certificate for all IBC documents/instruments; (b) voluntary GST registration under GST Act s.15, with right to remain outside the domestic VAT chain if turnover is below BZ$100,000; (c) exchange-control exemption under the IBC Act, removing the 180-day repatriation benchmark for offshore receipts; (d) for hybrid-mismatch purposes, Belize has adopted no OECD hybrid legislation, but an IBC that is tax-resident elsewhere may present its foreign tax certificate to BTS to confirm non-double taxation; no dual-inclusion or reverse-hybrid election is locally recognized.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Belize Goods and Services Tax (GST), a VAT-type system under the GST Act, Chapter 64, Laws of Belize (2006), administered by BTS.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: BZ$100,000 (≈US$50,000) aggregate annual value of taxable supplies made in Belize in any 12-month period; an equity crowdfunding IBC serving exclusively non-resident issuers/investors is outside the scope of Belize GST and is not required to register.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, API transaction validation or digital stamping mandate applies. Registered persons must issue sequential tax invoices (manual or electronic) showing the BTIN, date, description, consideration and GST charged, and retain them for 5 years; GST returns and customs declarations are filed electronically via the BTS portal and Customs Border Management System, but continuous transaction controls are not implemented.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Schedule 0 of the GST Act zero-rates: (a) goods physically exported from Belize within 30 days of supply (or such longer period as BTS approves); (b) services supplied to non-residents, performed wholly or partly outside Belize and not consumed in Belize — including crowdfunding platform fees, escrow facilitation and regulatory-compliance services where the issuer, the investors and the payment rails are non-resident and the benefit is enjoyed offshore; and (c) services directly related to exported goods. Zero-rating is conditioned on complete documentary substantiation, non-resident KYC, and a written BTS ruling if any portion of the service could be viewed as consumed in Belize.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Automated Export Declaration (AED) / Form CUS-EXP filed electronically via the Customs Border Management System
Original or electronic Bill of Lading, Airway Bill or equivalent carrier receipt evidencing physical export
Commercial invoice and signed platform services/escrow agreement for the crowdfunding engagement
Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) or SWIFT/ACH escrow credit advice proving foreign-currency settlement
Non-resident attestation and KYC file of the issuer, investors and target payment rails (ACH escrow and bank wire)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: BTS audit desks verify the export nexus, the 30-day dispatch rule for goods and the 180-day exchange-control benchmark for foreign-currency settlement. False zero-rating claims, forged export/escrow documents, or diversion of benefits to Belize residents constitute GST evasion under GST Act s.79, triggering reassessment of 12.5% GST, clawback of all input VAT credits, statutory interest at 1.5% per month, a civil penalty not exceeding the amount of tax undercharged, and, on summary conviction, a fine up to BZ$5,000 and/or imprisonment up to two years; directors and officers may be personally liable where the portal is used to defraud the revenue. The IBC's statutory tax exemption does not shield import transactions or taxable supplies consumed in Belize.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Belize dollar is pegged at BZD 2.00 per USD and is effectively fully convertible for current and capital account transactions involving International Business Companies. The IBC Act expressly removes an IBC from the domestic exchange control regime, so equity injection, distributions, dividends, and liquidation proceeds may be freely transferred to non-residents. No profit remittance approval is required provided the IBC maintains its non-resident status, pays annual licence fees, and does not transact with Belize residents or own locally-situated real property.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender or mandatory conversion rules apply to IBC export proceeds or trade receipts because IBCs are deemed non-residents for exchange control purposes. For domestic Belize exporters, the Exchange Control Regulations require repatriation of proceeds through an authorised dealer within 90 days of shipment and conversion to Belize dollars unless the Central Bank grants foreign currency retention for approved imports or debt service.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore fintech EMI solutions have low-to-medium viability for the crowdfunding portal. Central Bank policy and correspondent banking risk controls generally require domestic funding settlement through a Belize-licensed commercial bank. An FCA-regulated EMI may be used only for ancillary outbound expense payments, provided it is not used to hold investor escrow funds; local banks require proof of the EMI's regulatory licence and its ability to supply full payment-trail audit data.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A physical interview is mandatory for at least one director or senior compliance officer for higher-risk IBC entities. Remote onboarding is available only on a discretionary basis for existing customers, or when a licensed introducer and a Belize-qualified lawyer co-sign the KYC file. The equity crowdfunding portal should plan for a 4-to-6-week account-opening timeline and prepare board resolutions, certified passport copies, original utility bills, source-of-funds statements, and a legal opinion describing the portal's non-bank status.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Crowdfunding portal is classified as a money service or digital payment business by the AML compliance unit.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A licensed Belize counsel legal opinion confirming the portal is not a bank under the Belize Banking and Financial Institutions Act; IFSC regulatory classification letter; AML/CFT internal policy manual; customer onboarding and sanctions-screening procedures; and evidence that platform operations do not involve money transmission or deposit-taking.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Aggregation of many small investor distributions and third-party payments that trigger the 'transaction-laundering' red flag.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete investor KYC file with aggregate source-of-funds declarations; audited transaction trail from the platform's regulated escrow provider; restriction on payment via third-party credit cards; beneficial ownership registry; and monthly reconciliation certificates signed by an external auditor.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity investor funds should be routed through SWIFT MT103 wire transfers to the Belize IBC's USD account at a Tier 1 local bank, referencing the escrow subscription id. The remitter must use ISO 20022 purpose code 'GVER' (Equity Capital) or 'INCR' (Inflow of Capital) when required by correspondent banks. The escrow account must hold investor commitments in a separate segregated ledger, and a signed source-of-funds declaration covering each investor must be retained for AML audit purposes.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements to foreign beneficiaries are cleared via SWIFT MT103 messages through the bank's USD correspondent network (typically CITIUS33 for Fedwire/CHIPS). For trade-backed settlements involving platform operating infrastructure or acquired asset portfolios, irrevocable confirmed commercial letters of credit may be issued under UCP600; payment under such LCs is released through MT700 and subsequent MT103 settlement instructions. All outbound wires must comply with corresponding sanctions screening and exceed regulatory reporting thresholds.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/BZD forward contracts with authorised dealers under the Central Bank of Belize framework
Cross-currency swaps executed under ISDA 2002 Master Agreement with schedule and credit support annex
Interest rate and currency swaps for fixed-income escrow yield hedging, only with licensed commercial banks

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual IBC Government Licence Fee (renewal of Belize International Business Company registration; tier: authorized capital not exceeding USD 50,000)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Belize International Financial Services Commission (IFSC) — Registrar of International Business Companies, via the licensed Belize registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of incorporation each year (first year paid at formation; e.g., a company incorporated on 15 March renews by 15 March each year thereafter)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly late penalty of 10% of the unpaid fee for each month or part of a month in arrears; non-payment persisting for six months or more triggers administrative strike-off from the Belize Companies Register; restoration requires IFSC application, payment of all arrears and penalties, and a restoration fee.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: IFSC Crowdfunding Portal Licence Annual Renewal and Annual Compliance Certificate (equity crowdfunding authorization under the IFSC financial services licensing regime)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Belize IFSC — Financial Services Authorisation and Licensing Division
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of the licence issue date; renewal application must be lodged at least 30 calendar days before expiry; annual fee is the base rate in the IFSC published fee schedule
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Licence automatically lapses if renewal is not granted before expiry; carrying on crowdfunding intermediation without a renewed licence is a statutory offence under the IFSC Act punishable by fine and imprisonment; the IFSC may revoke the licence, disqualify directors, and strike off the entity.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Economic Substance Notification / Return (applicable if the IBC is tax resident in Belize and carries on a relevant activity such as financing/leasing or fund management in connection with the crowdfunding platform)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 12 months after the end of the IBC's financial year (rolling annual reporting period)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file attracts a fine of BZD 25,000 (approx. USD 12,500); continuing non-compliance attracts a further penalty of up to BZD 50,000 (approx. USD 25,000), liability of directors, exchange of information with the Belize Tax Information Exchange Unit, and potential strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual AML/CFT Compliance Report and Updated Compliance Risk Assessment (required of the licensed crowdfunding portal as a designated financial institution)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Belize Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU), with copy to the IFSC AML/CFT Supervision Division
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days of the end of each financial year; suspicious activity reports and wire-transfer threshold reports are filed continuously throughout the year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Statutory fines and imprisonment under the Money Laundering and Terrorism (Prevention) Act for non-filing or defective filing; supervisory action by the IFSC including licence suspension, revocation, and strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent Annual Compliance Attestation and Statutory Register Audit (confirmation that the Register of Members, Register of Directors, UBO Register, and Minute Book are maintained at the Belize registered office)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Belize IFSC / Companies Registry (submitted by the licensed registered agent in support of the annual renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Submitted together with the annual fee payment within 3 months before or on the anniversary of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: If the registered agent cannot attest to compliance, the Registrar issues a notice of non-compliance; unresolved default leads to administrative strike-off; knowingly false attestations expose the agent to fines and cancellation of its agent licence.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit is required for a non-licensed Belize IBC. The IFSC-licensed equity crowdfunding portal is unconditionally subject to annual audit by a Belize-licensed certified public accountant as a licence condition, with the audited financial statements (including statement of crowdfunding funds held in escrow) submitted with the licence renewal; no revenue or asset exemption applies to the licensed entity.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS for the licensed crowdfunding portal (and its escrow/trust accounts); Belize GAAP (converged with IFRS) is acceptable for the underlying IBC where no licensed activity is conducted. Books and records must be maintained in English and expressed in Belize dollars (USD equivalents acceptable).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Belize does not require a public annual UBO filing. The IBC must maintain a Beneficial Ownership Register at the registered office under the Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Act, 2018; the registered agent must obtain and refresh beneficial-owner declarations upon formation, on any shareholding transfer, and annually in the course of the licence renewal and register audit. Access is limited to the Registrar, the IFSC, and the Belize Tax Information Exchange Unit upon statutory demand. Any shareholding transfer during the year is recorded in the Register of Members and reflected in the agent's annual attestation.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of Director and Member Meetings

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 750 - 1,500 per annum (registered agent, registered office, corporate secretarial support, and KYC/UBO administration)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,500 - 8,000 per annum (annual audit of the licensed crowdfunding portal by a Belize-licensed CPA, including escrow funds verification)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (statutory exemption for International Business Companies under the International Business Companies Act, Ch. 270, s. 5; domestic Belize companies are chargeable at 25%)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Total exemption from income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, business tax, and stamp duty on share capital. The exemption is locked for the life of the IBC while it remains in good standing, is administered as a non-resident entity, and does not transact with Belize residents. If the IBC carries on Belize-source domestic business, the exemption is forfeited and the Income Tax Act applies.
